chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Farqad, from Fadhl [Fudhayl] al-Ghassan, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who recites Surah Yunus every two or three months will not be feared that he is among the ignorant, and he will be among the near ones on the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبِينَ: The near ones (a high rank in Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Yunus regularly?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith emphasizes the transformative power of consistent recitation, linking the specific rhythm of every two to three months to spiritual purification from *al-jahiliyyah* (ignorance). It promises the high station of *al-muqarrabun* (the Near Ones), reflecting the Shia tradition's focus on the interplay between ritual practice and eschatological elevation through the virtues of specific Quranic chapters.
